_note: Tempering techniques: passive cultivation of the body. [C] they work by harming the body so it adapts; each has a stage and a 0-100% progress bar; they are grouped by affinity. [B] all of them run at once and simply make the body tougher. [I] the stage cap is star count + 1, as for abilities. Everything else here is ours [MODEL]: the techniques themselves (names, effects, numbers - none is taken from the books), training by sessions that deal structural damage, and a character starting with the plain one plus one per affinity it holds. affinity '' means anyone can train it. effect.stat is one of: max_superficial, max_structural (hit points added per stage), reflux_shed_mult, incoming_mult, move_speed_mult, melee_cooldown_mult (multiplied in once per stage).

session._note: One training session. damage is dealt to the structural layer and must leave at least min_structural_left; progress is percent of the current stage.

callus.name: Callus
callus.verse: Be struck until the striking is no longer news.
callus.desc: The plain way: take the beating, and keep a little of it.

slow_tide.name: Slow Tide
slow_tide.verse: What the body cannot hold, teach it to pour out.
slow_tide.desc: Drown the channels in your own essence until they learn to drain.

kiln_cured.name: Kiln-Cured Hide
kiln_cured.verse: Fire the clay and it stops being clay.
kiln_cured.desc: Scald the skin from the inside, a little past what it can bear, and let it set.

bedrock_bones.name: Bedrock Bones
bedrock_bones.verse: Break along the grain. Heal across it.
bedrock_bones.desc: Load the frame until it cracks, and mend it denser each time.

thin_air_lungs.name: Thin Air Lungs
thin_air_lungs.verse: Run where there is nothing to breathe. Come back needing less.
thin_air_lungs.desc: Starve the lungs until the legs stop asking them for permission.

live_wire.name: Live Wire Nerves
live_wire.verse: Let it through you until you stop flinching. Then let more through.
live_wire.desc: Burn the hesitation out of the nerves, one jolt at a time.
